```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Setup

```{r packages, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Read Data

```{r read-data, message=FALSE}
hourly_rides <- read_csv("data/hour.csv") %>%
  mutate(workingday = case_when(workingday == 1 ~ "workday",
                                          TRUE ~ "weekend"),
         ) %>%
  select(
    date = dteday,
    hour = hr,
    season,
    year = yr,
    holiday,
    workingday = workingday,
    day_of_week = weekday,
    weather_type = weathersit,
    temp,
    feels_like = atemp,
    humidity = hum,
    windspeed,
    casual,
    registered,
    total = cnt
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(c(season, year, hour, holiday, workingday, day_of_week, weather_type), as.factor)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(c(casual, registered, total),
               names_to = "member_type",
               values_to = "rides")
hourly_rides %>% glimpse()
```

# Overall summary

```{r}
library(skimr)
skim(hourly_rides)
```


```{r}
hourly_rides %>%
  filter(member_type != "total") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = day_of_week, y = rides, color = member_type)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```

```{r fig.height=10}
hourly_rides %>%
  filter(member_type != "total") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = hour, x = rides, color = member_type)) + 
    geom_boxplot() +
    facet_wrap(~ member_type, scales = "free_x")
```

```{r}
hourly_rides %>%
  filter(member_type != "total") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = temp, y = rides, color = member_type)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_smooth()
```
